summary: Painted hatched area at a corner by the shopping centre; nowhere to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Shopping centre wall beside it; no homes close, but fully exposed to the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: The kerb is a short curved corner with hatching painted on it; no room to pull out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy corner by shopping centre service road and Grosvenor Road.
drivers.convention: No signs mapped; no cars park here.

sun_shade: Open; shopping centre wall shades the west side in the morning.
